method.gallery: site/livepatch/matgallery/matgallery-v5.html rows (682). Combo = JS combo(): every chip must be in primary/also (x[5]) or accent (x[8]) or holiday accent (x[10]); retired rows hidden while "Hide retired" is on (default). Single chip = section: x[5] or x[8].
method.albums: 37 live *-mahjong-tile-matches pages via curl; both caption layouts (regular card + holiday Matchmaker's pick, h3 "Set + Mat"). Holiday cards excluded from counts (holiday mats live only in combos via measured hacc). Duplicate rows (e.g. Lorelei 2) deduped.
method.set_colors: config/tile-tones.json (dominant: Tiffany-stated where src=tiffany, else photo read; colors list) is the base; second/third colors from the Tile Edit color-card captions on the album pages (her words, e.g. Lagoon "accented with berry and plum", Seabreeze "Teal and hot pink") and the measured tile palette (tile-tones palette, families.fam_arr). Album hub /mahjong-tile-matches gives only one color per set. Lagoon combo = Tiffany's own test (Teal + Pink).
method.color_present: an album mat "should" show in a combo when every combo color is already tagged or measured >= 3% (blue and teal pooled) in config/mat-accent-colors.json. Mats that match a set on harmony but do not contain the colors are not expected in a color filter.

Elysium.eye_check: Photo: navy + lime with a teal frame and pink florals. Has pink (her accent call) but teal 11.7% (< 15% teal threshold) and teal is blanket-removed for Tiffany-called mats. Fixed by A3 (album-confirmed teal) or B (blue counts as teal).

Pink Winds.eye_check: Photo: pale blue/aqua watercolor border with a lilac-pink centre. Measured purple 47 / blue 44.2 / green 8.9, pink 0, teal 0: aqua read as blue, lilac read as purple. Fixed for teal by B (merge); pink needs a per-mat tag.

reason: NOT IN GALLERY: hidden_oct20.csv: already out (held low-confidence list); would also be hidden: image shows no mat: photo of dogs on a ski lift
Gray Malin.eye_check: Not in gallery: held-low-98 + hidden_oct20.csv ("image shows no mat: photo of..."). Needs a clean flat mat photo before it can enter.

Watercolor Blooms.eye_check: Photo: aqua border, pink florals, pink centre: clearly teal + pink. Teal 36.4 (accent) but pink 11.5% is 0.5 under the 12% threshold (the cream tube in the photo inflates neutral to 49.5). Fixed by A3 or a 11% threshold.

Esme.eye_check: Photo: teal/aqua mat with pink florals. Pink measured 6.5% (< 12% accent threshold). Album-confirmed rule (A3) fixes it.

Jade.eye_check: Photo: blue + blue-green leaves, no visible pink. Teal measured 24.3% but dropped: build_v5.py line 374 adds teal to REMOVED for every mat Tiffany gave a final call, and her accent_calls (neutral, purple) replace measured accents. Pink 0%. Shows under Teal only if the blanket teal removal is dropped; under Teal+Pink only with a per-mat pink tag (photo does not support it).

Mirage.eye_check: Photo: hot pink/red field with clearly teal palm motifs in the center panel. Measured pink 65.7 / red 26.6 / neutral 7.7, teal 0: the k-means cluster read swallowed the small teal motifs. Measurement wrong -> per-mat tag (teal) needed; also retired (hidden by default).
